artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan: confirm the already-landed library half (no Lean edits), then amend the dependent records (761 carrier repair, 763 index deletion recorded as an open sub-problem, 762 untouched), the design of record, two roadmap bullets, the RaySummary README and the probe-gate comment, closing with the full gate.

memory_candidates.content: When a machine-checked refutation invalidates a claim that successor task records were built on, the amendment spans four record layers that must move together: the state.json task descriptions (via state-write.sh, scoped by project_number, with jq -S del(...) equality against HEAD to prove siblings untouched), the design-of-record spec and its generated-from JSON in the originating task directory, the authored ROADMAP bullets (re-read before edit; conclusion-stage regeneration retains authored sections), and the non-specs README open-obligation item plus any gate-script comment that still calls the claim open. Delete the refuted claim and record it as an open sub-problem; never re-state it over an unproved substitute. Before planning a transplant the description calls for, re-measure the tree: a predecessor's later round may already have landed it (the overlap hazard is usually flagged in that predecessor's plan under an 'out of scope' heading).
